measurement.rss: process.memoryUsage().rss; per process, never exclusive application footprint
measurement.privateMemory: process.getProcessMemoryInfo().private, KiB converted to bytes; pre-compression private memory, not physical footprint
measurement.privateBytes: Electron ProcessMetric privateBytes, Windows only; null on macOS
measurement.footprint: N/A unless independently measured with Instruments/VM Tracker
measurement.gpu: GPU process working set only; IOSurface allocation N/A
measurement.cold: Fresh application/profile/SQLite connection; OS filesystem cache is not flushed
measurement.cpu: CPU microseconds and Electron interval averages, reported separately from latency

limitations: Ordinary prebuilt production dist; each independent round uses a fresh app process and isolated profile. This runner does not build the app. OS filesystem caches remain warm.
One aggregate sample per scenario per round. Twenty switches and individual RAF/input events inside a round are not independent runs. P50/P95 use nearest rank; with five rounds P95 is the maximum.
frameIntervalMs and inputToSecondRafMs columns summarize per-round distribution statistics, not a pooled event distribution. Missing distributions remain null, with explicit missingSamples counts.

Short CDP trace/RAF observers add overhead. RAF cadence is not compositor FPS; input-to-second-RAF is a paint opportunity proxy. Heap and DOM are point samples, not peak memory or proof of absence of leaks.

No React profiling, 30-minute idle or sustained-stream claim. Synthetic local fixtures do not measure external model or scholarly services. Raw child reports remain embedded; temporary child JSON/Markdown and profiles are removed.

limitations: UI scale workloads use the production built app and IPC with 100 generated projects, 12,100 generated library records and seeded user-message histories. They do not measure real user data or external scholarly/model services.

Library scales are explicit query subsets; every page is loaded via the production Load more action before End/scroll. Stream scenarios add 500/5000 local SSE chunks to 500/5000 persisted user messages, not 500/5000 independent model runs.
Workload tracing and RAF sampling add overhead. RAF cadence is not compositor FPS; input-to-second-RAF is a paint-opportunity proxy. Raw CDP traces are opt-in via ROC_PERF_RAW_TRACE_DIR.

UI scale scenarios run once per invocation; --samples controls independent startup samples. Continuous streaming requires the separately configured sustainedStream scenario; short 500/5000-chunk runs do not establish 30-minute behavior.
Fresh isolated profiles/launches; OS filesystem cache remains warm.
Renderer DOM and JS heap are CDP point-in-time samples after history readiness; neither peak heap nor a leak verdict. Fixture events are user messages, not streaming model output.
When hidden idle is selected, native close-to-hide and second-instance reopen exercise production host forwarding; hidden checkpoints confirm the Renderer received hidden=true.
Summed working sets include shared pages; not application exclusive footprint.
CPU interval averages share app.getAppMetrics sampling intervals with diagnostics.
Idle visibility is asserted in both BrowserWindow and Renderer forwarding. visible+hidden observes two separate intervals in that order; checkpoints alone cannot prove zero activity between samples.

mainCpuOneCorePercent uses process.cpuUsage delta / elapsed wall time; 100% means one logical CPU core. It is not normalized by host logical CPU count and differs from Electron process interval metrics.
PDF/OCR, background-busy and long idle are separate explicitly selected workloads; this startup report does not establish them.
